units.rawText: I've seen all kinds of people before. Some wanted me to sacrifice everything for them, but they didn't give me a single thing in return for it. Others sacrificed everything for me, but I was powerless to repay them.

units.rawText: But Professor... you're different from them. When I'm with you, I can feel just how valuable my own existence is.

spans.text: But Professor... you're different from them. When I'm with you, I can feel just how valuable my own existence is.

units.rawText: —Ack, getting all serious like that made me want to hurl. Okay, this lollipop's for you. Don't ask about it anymore. Finish your sugar resupply and then begin the day's work, Professor.
